Glazing and weathering

Insulated glazing uses clear tempered safety glass with exterior-applied simulated divided-lite bars. Factory weatherstrip includes compression jamb seals, adjustable sweep, and thermally broken aluminum sill. Seal perimeter joints with compatible exterior-grade sealant.
Finish and care

Warm White is a low-sheen factory coating. Touch up exposed fasteners and minor handling damage with BRD repair finish. Do not clean glazing or coated surfaces with abrasive pads, solvents, or alkaline masonry wash.
FABRICATION HOLD POINT

Field verify rough opening, handing, sill condition, exterior trim depth, and hardware preparation before release. Supplier dimensions are nominal leaf sizes. Coordinate final unit dimensions with approved shop drawings.

Aged finish

Select birch veneer for compatible tone within each room group. The aged
clear finish retains small dents, softened edges, and natural color variation
associated with salvaged millwork. Seal both faces and every edge.
Machining limits

Factory machine for specified hardware where final handing is available.
Maximum field trim is 1/8 inch at each stile, 1/4 inch at top rail, and 1/2
inch at bottom rail. Reseal every cut edge before installation.
STORAGE REQUIREMENT

Store doors flat on level supports in a dry, ventilated interior space. Keep doors wrapped until the building is enclosed and wet work has dried. Do not
install when relative humidity or temperature differs materially from expected occupied conditions.

VIRGINIA FARMHOUSE INSTALLATION, WARRANTY, AND CLOSEOUT
EXECUTION AND CLOSEOUT
Installation requirements

1 Delivery and storage Deliver units in unopened protective wrapping. Inspect for transit damage on arrival. Store flat, level, dry, and out of direct sunlight. Keep exterior assemblies upright only when supported at head and sill.

2 Opening verification Confirm opening size, plumb, level, square, wall thickness, sill support, and finish clearances. Do not install into an opening that exceeds manufacturer tolerance or contains active moisture.

3 Exterior installation Set frames plumb and square. Shim at hinges, strike, sill, and fastener locations. Flash sill and perimeter in sequence with the wall weather barrier. Seal interior and exterior perimeter joints.

4 Interior installation Allow doors to acclimate in occupied-range conditions. Fit leaves for uniform clearances without binding. Reseal field cuts, install hardware without splitting, and adjust operation before acceptance.

5 Protection and cleaning Protect faces, edges, glazing, and finish from impact, moisture, paint, plaster, and masonry wash. Remove labels with manufacturer-approved cleaner. Replace damaged units that cannot be repaired invisibly.
Limited warranty

One year from substantial completion against manufacturing defects
in materials and workmanship. Warranty excludes improper storage,
field alteration beyond published limits, and uncontrolled moisture
exposure.
Closeout deliverables

Provide approved schedule, finish touch-up material, care instructions,
warranty certificate, and final model list. Record approved substitutions
and field changes in the closeout package.
